subject: EdgeScale + Redwood: CloudCon West joint booth & webinar — planning
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Roberts <jane@marketloop.com>; EdgeScale Ops <ops@edgescale.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeScale + Redwood: CloudCon West joint booth & webinar — planning

Hi Jane / EdgeScale team,

Great to meet on the call yesterday — excited about a joint presence at CloudCon West (Sept 14–16). I put together a short starter SOW and MDF outline (attached) that covers: shared booth footprint, cost split, lead handling, and a co-branded webinar as a lead gen primer the week before the show.

Top asks so we can move towards an MOU:
- Confirm budget slab for MDF and expected lead share (split or CPL).
- OK on a 10x10 shared booth with a micro-demo area and two speaking slots.
- Lead routing: webhook to our CRM + nightly CSV backfill to yours?
- Sign-off on SOW (attached) or propose edits by next Fri (4/17).

Attachments: SOW_CoMarketing_EdgeScale_v1.pdf, MDF_Terms_v2.xlsx

If useful, I can set a 30m planning call next week to walk the run-of-show.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

--

From: Jane Roberts <jane@marketloop.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: EdgeScale Ops <ops@edgescale.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah@edgescale.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeScale + Redwood: CloudCon West joint booth & webinar — planning

Ben — thanks for the doc and clear asks. A few clarifying Qs from our side before we commit: 

1) MDF slab: can you break the MDF line items into advertising vs. staffing vs. creative? We prefer fixed line items rather than a pooled slab.
2) Lead sharing: EdgeScale’s legal requires hashed PII only; can we do hashed email + timestamp in the webhook?
3) Speaking slots: can one slot be reserved for a customer case study (we have a reference at MarketLoop)?

We’re generally positive on the joint webinar. Would need a draft run-of-show and proposed panel moderator by 4/24 to lock our marketing calendar.

Cc’ing our ops team (Sarah) to confirm lead-export constraints and DocuSign flow.

Best,
Jane Roberts
Head of Growth (Market Partnerships) — EdgeScale
jane@marketloop.com

--

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Jane Roberts <jane@marketloop.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeScale Ops <ops@edgescale.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeScale + Redwood: CloudCon West joint booth & webinar — planning

Quick note from ops side — good questions. A couple of operational proposals:

- MDF line items: we can convert the slab into discrete SKU lines (Ad credit, Booth Build, Creative, Meals) and set caps for each. I’ll attach a sample budget table in the next update.
- Lead webhook: we can send hashed_email (SHA256), event_ts, lead_source, utm_campaign. We’ll retain full PII internally for the 30-day SLA for routing, but sharing to EdgeScale will be hashed per their ask.
- Webhook latency: target sub-2min average; if EdgeScale needs realtime low-latency we can add a dedicated queue but that’s additional.

Also — recommend a 45m sync the week of 4/20 to map the run-of-show and allocate booth shifts. Three goals for that call: finalize MDF split, align speaker brief, and agree lead processing.

Jonas
Senior Partnerships Ops — Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com

Jane / Sarah — thanks, all good feedback. I attached an updated SOW that:
- Breaks MDF into discrete line items (Ad, Booth Build, Travel & Meals, Creative).
- Adds a clause for the hashed-lead webhook (SHA256) + nightly hashed CSV export if you need reconciliation.
- Reserves one webinar speaker slot for your MarketLoop case study and suggests our Head of Product as moderator.

I also created a DocuSign envelope for the SOW + MDF terms to speed approval: https://www.docusign.com/en/verify/example-sign (placeholder link). Can you review and either sign or redline by 4/24?

Next steps:
- Please review attached "CloudCon-Booth-RunOfShow.docx" and propose edits by 4/21.
- Jonas / Marissa — once legal confirms hashed export wording, please push final to DocuSign.
- Jane / Sarah — if you’re available Friday 4/17 at 10am PT we can do the 45m sync; otherwise propose an alternative.

Attachments: SOW_CoMarketing_EdgeScale_v1.pdf (updated), MDF_Terms_v2.xlsx (updated), CloudCon-Booth-RunOfShow.docx

Thanks — looking forward to locking space.

Ben

- Please add a small clause for lead retention period (we ask 90 days for hashed reconciliation).
- Can we add a shared Slack channel (Redwood-EdgeScale-CloudCon) for day-of coordination and lead triage?
